content: अपार {%a.%} .²1 Shoreless. .²2 Boundless, unbounded, unlimited; अपारस्याप्रमेयस्य परं पारमुपाश्रिते <ls>Rām.</ls> unfathomable, of great length. .²3 Inexhaustible, immense, great (अधिक); अपारो वो महिमा <ls>Rv. 5. 87. 6</ls>. .²4 Out of reach. .²5 Difficult to be crossed; difficult to be surmounted or overcome (as an enemy); रावणश्च महाशत्रुरपारः प्रतिभाति मे . <ls>Rām.</ls> .{@-रः@} An ocean; कर्णधार इवापारे भगवान्पारदर्शकः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 13. 39</ls>. .{@-रम्@} .²1 A kind of mental satisfaction or acquiescence; or, reverse of mental acquiescence, non-acquiescence. .²2 The opposite bank of a river. .{@-रा@} The earth. .{@-पार@} {%a.%} Carrying over the boundless sea.
